dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is an order from the Fontaine Research Institute, Hautemontagne!

dialogues.speaker: Hautemontagne
dialogues.text: Bah! *coughs* What are you doing? Why did you scare me like that?

dialogues.speaker: Hautemontagne
dialogues.text: I just wasted a good cup of tea... You had me thinking that they needed people so badly that they've come to kidnap me!
